name: io.github.ValorBrain/valorbrain
title: ValorBrain
description: Shared memory for AI agents and teams: store, search and correct dated facts and decisions.

environmentVariables.name: VALORBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ValorBrain MCP token (vbm_...). Optional when `npx -y @valorbrain/cli@latest init --agent` already saved it in ~/.valorbrain/config.json.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP token (vbm_...). Get one with `npx -y @valorbrain/cli@latest init --agent`, or create it in the app. Clients that sign in with OAuth do not send this header.

mcp_token.description: ValorBrain MCP token, starts with vbm_
